mentions.name: Lingolingo
mentions.description: This app turns YouTube's large collection of spoken-language videos into an accessible language learning resource, with a focus on mobile use. It currently focuses on Chinese (Mandarin) while also supporting other languages.
mentions.problem: YouTube likely has the largest collection of spoken language that ever existed, but it is not easily accessible as a language learning resource, especially on mobile.
mentions.audience: Language learners, especially learners of Mandarin Chinese
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an app for language learning with Youtube. I realized that yt probably has the largest collection of spoken language that ever existed, so I wanted to make it accessible, especially on mobile.
